children: The Indian rupee may garner "some near-term relief" from the Reserve Bank of India's additional FX measures unveiled over the weekend to contain depreciation pressures, two strategists at OCBC Group Research say in a research report. "Effective 12 October, the RBI will provide USD through a special window to meet the entire daily USD requirements of three state-owned oil companies, reducing a significant source of demand in the spot FX market," the strategists note. The central bank also tightened FX derivative rules, they add. The dollar closed little changed at 96.7600 rupees last Friday, LSEG data show.(ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
